correctness.rationale: Both source naïve formulas reduce to \(\lambda\operatorname{rank}(P)+\lambda\|(I-P)\omega\|_2^2\) for \(A=\lambda I_2\), because the Moore–Penrose Nyström reconstruction equals \(\lambda P\). Two independent equiprobable projective sign lines give exactly three disjoint pattern classes; their counts \(2\), \(2k\), and \(2^k-2-2k\) give the complete joint law. Exact averaging proves unbiasedness, mean-squared trace error, posterior mean, correlation, and sharp stopping threshold intervals. The standalone exact-rational verification enumerates every sign-vector family for \(3\le k\le8\) and checks the Nyström pseudoinverse projector identity. Finite enumeration verifies transcription only; the general proof is analytic.

value.rationale: The paper explicitly proposes a posterior squared-error proxy and adaptive early stopping to choose matrix-vector-product budgets. On the smallest nontrivial positive definite flat-spectrum matrix with an experimental sign-vector choice, the complete finite-\(k\) distribution gives exact failure probabilities, an arbitrarily growing \(k+1\) mean-square calibration factor, and a zero-indicated-error event with 50% true relative error. It distinguishes the correlation-based stopping diagnostic from the generally unbiased estimator and calibrates an operationally meaningful reliability gap; the absolute error and event probability decay exponentially, as disclosed.
